title: Netherlands – Public road transport services – Mobiliteitskaarten en aanverwante dienstverlening
description: Per 2026 zijn in de cao Werken voor Waterschappen nieuwe mobiliteitsafspraken opgenomen. Eén van deze afspraken is dat de werkgever de werknemer op diens verzoek een openbaarvervoerkaart ter beschikking kan stellen in ruil voor de bestaande vergoeding voor woon-werkverkeer. De directie van Waterschap AGV heeft op basis van het directievoorstel mobiliteitsregeling AGV besloten de mobiliteitsregeling in te voeren. Daarbij heeft de directie als uitgangspunten vastgesteld dat de regeling moet bijdragen aan: • duurzamer reisgedrag van medewerkers; • goed werkgeverschap; • het stimuleren van aanwezigheid en ontmoeting op kantoor; • een uitvoerbare en beheersbare inrichting van processen en systemen. Om deze directiekeuze tijdig, rechtmatig en doelmatig te kunnen uitvoeren, is het noodzakelijk een geschikte marktpartij te contracteren voor de levering en uitvoering van de openbaar vervoer voorziening. Het inkooptraject is erop gericht een contractpartij te selecteren die niet alleen de mobiliteitskaart levert, maar ook de bijbehorende dienstverlening kan bieden die nodig is voor implementatie, beheer, rapportage, ondersteuning van gebruikers en een verwerkbare aansluiting op HR-, financiële en salarisprocessen.

title: Netherlands – Sewage services – Raamovereenkomst Reinigen, preventief en correctief onderhoud mechanische installaties SWWB de Baronie 2027-2028
description: Procedure Aanbesteding middels de Europees openbare procedure conform de hoofdstuk 2 ARW 2016. Opdrachtgever De opdrachtgever bij deze aanbesteding is de Gemeente Breda. Voor meer informatie over de Gemeente Breda verwijzen wij u naar de website van de gemeente: www.breda.nl. Deelnemers zijn naast de Gemeente Breda: Gemeente Alphen-Chaam, Gemeente Baarle-Nassau, Gemeente Gilze en Rijen, Baarle-Hertog en Gemeente Etten-Leur. Opdracht De opdracht betreft het reinigen en het preventief en correctief onderhouden van de mechanische installaties 2027-2028 binnen de deelnemende gemeenten van het Samenwerkingsverband Waterbeheer West-Brabant (SWWB). Percelen Deze opdracht is verdeeld in de volgende percelen: Perceel 1: ABG-organisatie (Gemeente Alphen-Chaam, Gemeente Baarle-Nassau en Gemeente Gilze en Rijen) en Baarle-Hertog; Perceel 2: Gemeente Etten-Leur; Perceel 3: Gemeente Breda. Doel Het doel van deze aanbesteding is om voor de dienstverlening per perceel een raamovereenkomst te sluiten met één opdrachtnemer met een looptijd van 2 jaar met als ingangsdatum 1 januari 2027. De opdrachtgever heeft het recht deze overeenkomst, met tweemaal met één jaar te verlengen. De opdrachtgever zal minimaal 6 maanden voor het aflopen van het contract, de aannemer schriftelijk op de hoogte stellen of de opdrachtgever van de optie tot verlenging van het contract gebruik zal maken. Anders eindigt het contract automatisch na het bereiken van de einddatum. Minimale termijn van 6 maanden geldt ook voor de optie jaren. Eventuele verlenging geschiedt onder gelijkblijvende condities en voorwaarden. De opdrachtgevers kunnen elk individueel besluiten om al dan niet tot verlenging van de overeenkomst over te gaan zonder dat dit consequenties heeft in welke vorm dan ook voor de overige individuele opdrachtgevers. Maximale contractwaarde De maximale opdrachtwaarde in het kader van deze raamovereenkomst wordt gesteld op: Perceel 1: ABG- - organisatie (Gemeente Alphen-Chaam, Gemeente Baarle-Nassau en Gemeente Gilze en Rijen) en Baarle-Hertog € 1.700.000,-; Perceel 2: Gemeente Etten-Leur € 1.100.000,-; Perceel 3: Gemeente Breda € 1.200.000-,. bezien over de looptijd van de overeenkomst, inclusief verlengingsopties. Aan het genoemde bedrag kunnen geen rechten worden ontleend. Voor opdrachtgever geldt geen afnameverplichting. Mercell Deze aanbesteding zal uitsluitend en geheel digitaal online worden afgehandeld via het Mercell platform (www.mercell.com). Een uitgebreide instructie met betrekking tot digitaal aanbesteden treft u aan in de Vragenlijsten.

title: Q501--STAT CLINICAL LAB TESTING AND AUTOPSIES
description: 15 The Department of Veterans Affairs, Veterans Integrated Service Network (VISN) 2, Health Service Area (HSA) 2.1, Network Contracting Office (NCO) 6, is conducting market research to determine the availability and capability of qualified businesses to provide comprehensive referral laboratory testing, specimen transportation, and autopsy services for the Central Virginia VA Health Care System, including Hunter Holmes McGuire VA Medical Center. The Government is seeking information from Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Businesses (SDVOSBs), Veteran-Owned Small Businesses (VOSBs), and other Small Business concerns, including 8(a), Historically Underutilized Business Zone (HUBZone), Women-Owned Small Business (WOSB), and Economically Disadvantaged Women-Owned Small Business (EDWOSB) concerns. The anticipated North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) code is 621511, Medical Laboratories. The applicable small business size standard is $45.5 million. This Sources Sought Notice is issued solely for market research and acquisition-planning purposes. It does not constitute a solicitation, request for quotation, invitation for bid, or request for proposal. Submission of a response does not obligate the Government to issue a future solicitation or award a contract. I. GENERAL SCOPE OF SERVICES The contemplated requirement is for a contractor to provide a full range of referral laboratory and autopsy services. The contractor shall be capable of supporting both clinical pathology and anatomic pathology requirements. Required services are anticipated to include, but are not limited to: Performing analytical testing described in the contractor s reference test manual and the Government s attached test list. Receiving, processing, analyzing, and maintaining the integrity of clinical and anatomic pathology specimens. Reporting test results within established turnaround times. Providing routine, urgent, and STAT testing, as applicable. Providing consultative services concerning: Test selection; Specimen collection; Specimen handling and preservation; Transportation requirements; and Interpretation of test results. Providing supplies and materials required for the collection and transportation of specimens, as applicable. Providing secure transportation of specimens from Government-designated collection locations to the testing laboratory. Providing electronic access to test information and patient results. Providing hospital or medical autopsy services, including gross and microscopic examination, final reports, and related professional consultation. Coordinating transportation arrangements associated with autopsy services, if required by the Government. The anticipated service area includes Hunter Holmes McGuire VA Medical Center and any associated Central Virginia VA Health Care System locations identified in the resulting solicitation. The final solicitation, if issued, will establish the definitive scope, locations, quantities, schedules, performance standards, and reporting requirements. II. LICENSURE, CERTIFICATION, AND ACCREDITATION Any reference laboratory performing services under the contemplated requirement, including a branch, division, affiliate, or subcontracted laboratory, shall possess all licenses, certifications, accreditations, and inspections required by applicable federal and state laws and regulations. Respondents shall identify their current laboratory accreditations and certifications, which may include: Certification under the Clinical Laboratory Improvement Amendments of 1988 (CLIA); Accreditation through an accrediting organization with deemed status from the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS), such as: College of American Pathologists (CAP); COLA; or The Joint Commission; Applicable Nuclear Regulatory Commission licenses; Applicable federal and state laboratory licenses or certifications; and Any other certification or accreditation required for the proposed testing or autopsy services. The contractor shall comply with applicable requirements governing the privacy and security of protected health information, including the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act and its implementing regulations. Respondents shall identify the accreditation and certification status of every location that may perform testing or autopsy services, including proposed subcontractors and third-party reference laboratories. III. SPECIMEN TRANSPORTATION AND STAT TESTING Respondents shall describe their ability to provide secure and timely transportation of clinical and anatomic pathology specimens from Government-designated collection locations. As well as the capability to provide hospital or medical autopsy services, including: IV. CAPABILITY-STATEMENT REQUIREMENTS Interested parties shall submit a capability statement demonstrating their ability to satisfy the contemplated requirement. Responses should include: Legal name and address of the firm. Unique Entity Identifier. Point of contact, telephone number, and email address. Business size and socioeconomic status under NAICS code 621511, including, as applicable: SDVOSB; VOSB; 8(a); HUBZone; WOSB; EDWOSB; or Other Small Business. Confirmation of the firm s current SAM.gov registration status. Confirmation that any claimed veteran-owned status is verified in the applicable Small Business Administration veteran-certification system. A detailed capability statement addressing the laboratory testing, transportation, STAT testing, and autopsy requirements described in this notice. The number of years the firm has provided comparable laboratory or autopsy services. Relevant experience providing similar services to federal agencies, VA medical facilities, hospitals, or other healthcare systems. Current licenses, certifications, and accreditations. Identification of the location or locations where testing and autopsy services would be performed. A description of the firm s courier and specimen-transportation network. A description of the firm s electronic ordering and result-reporting capabilities. Identification of any proposed subcontractors, affiliates, branches, or third-party reference laboratories and the services each would perform. A description of how the respondent would perform the requirement while complying with FAR 52.219-14, Limitations on Subcontracting, if applicable. Identification of any services the respondent cannot provide. Any recommendations concerning contract structure, performance period, test-list organization, pricing method, or other matters that may improve competition or performance. Respondents should clearly distinguish between services performed by the prime contractor and services performed by subcontractors or third-party laboratories. V. RESPONSE INSTRUCTIONS Capability statements should not exceed five pages, excluding the cover page and copies of licenses, certifications, or accreditations. Responses shall be submitted electronically no later than: October 27, 2026, at 1:00 p.m. ET Submit responses by email to: Gordon Burns Network Contracting Office 6 VA Medical Center 27 Averill Avenue Hampton, VA 23667 Email: gordon.burns@va.gov The email subject line shall state: 36C24627Q0079 Autopsies and Lab Testing This Sources Sought Notice is issued for market research and acquisition-planning purposes only. It is not a solicitation, request for quotation, invitation for bid, or request for proposal. The Government is not requesting pricing or formal offers at this time. Responses will assist the Government in determining the availability and capability of qualified businesses and in developing an appropriate acquisition strategy. title: Switzerland – Construction work – Montagebau in Holz
description: Der geplante Neubau des Primarschulhauses Allmend verfolgt das Ziel, eine zukunftsfähige, nachhaltige und pädagogisch funktionale Infrastruktur für die Primarstufe 1 bis 6 zu schaffen. Der viergeschossige Baukörper wird in konventioneller Holzbauweise auf dem Schulareal errichtet und ersetzt dort die bestehende Aussensportanlage („Roter Platz“). Die geologischen und hydrogeologischen Rahmenbedingungen auf dem Areal gelten als anspruchsvoll. Es sind insbesondere zwei voneinander zu trennende Grundwasserstockwerke zu berücksichtigen. Der Baugrund verlangt eine Pfahlgründung (Betonverdrängungsbohrpfähle), auch für Werkleitungen und Kontrollschächte (Holzpfähle). Im Hinblick auf den Hochwasserschutz erfüllt der Neubau die Anforderungen HQ300- Die Haustechnik wird im Erdgeschoss und obersten Geschoss platziert (kein UG), um Schäden durch Hochwasserereignisse zu vermeiden. Die Tragstruktur des Gebäudes basiert auf einem Massivholzskelett aus Fi/Ta. Ergänzt wird dieses durch drei massive Servicekerne aus Stahlbeton. Die Wendeltreppen zwischen den Servicekernen sind ebenfalls in Stahlbeton ausgeführt. Die Fassade besteht aus vorgefertigten Holzständer-Aussenelementen. Das Gebäude wird nach SNBS 2.1 Hochbau zertiﬁziert (Ziel ist Gold Zertiﬁzierung). Die Energieversorgung erfolgt über einen Anschluss an das lokale Fernwärmenetz SeeEnergy (Winter Wärme, Sommer Kühlwasser). Alle Flächen werden mit Fussbodenheizung ausgelegt. Alle Bodenbeläge sind aus geschliffenem industriellem Beton und dienen als Speichermasse und leichtes Free-Cooling hinsichtlich sommerlicher Überhitzungsstunden. Die Regelung erfolgt über Raumtemperaturfühler und ist Nutzern abhängig. Zur Stromgewinnung wird eine gebäudeintegrierte Photovoltaikanlage auf dem Dach als wasserführende Gebäudehülle installiert. Brise-Soleil-konstruktion aus Metall entlang den Fassaden Ost und West dienen als Schattenwerfer und bilden den konstruktiven Witterungsschutz der Fassade. Im Bereich der Gebäudetechnik wird auf nur in den Bereichen der innenliegenden Kerne und der Aula den Einbau einer mechanischen Lüftungsanlage vorgesehen. Die Klassenzimmer erhalten Frischluft über eine manuelle natürliche Fensterlüftung. Das Gebäude ist vollständig hindernisfrei nutzbar. Für das geplante Schulgebäude mit einer Gesamthöhe von ca. 19 m in Hybridbauweise gilt als Gebäude mittlerer Höhe. Die brandschutztechnische Planung erfolgt gemäss Qualitätsstufe QSS 2 der BS-Richtlinie der VKF. Die Umgebungsgestaltung orientiert sich am Gestaltungskonzept „Zentrum 1. + 2. Etappe“ und trägt zur Entwicklung eines einheitlichen öffentlichen Freiraums im Zentrum Horw bei. Der Schulhaus-Pausenplatz wird als verkehrsfreier, öffentlich zugänglicher Raum ausgestaltet, mit Rücksicht auf die ausserschulische Mitbenutzung. Der Schulhausgarten dient ausschliesslich der schulischen Nutzung und ist entsprechend kindgerecht und naturnah gestaltet. Im Sinne der Klimaanpassung und Biodiversitätsförderung werden.

description: Електрическа подстанция (п/ст) „Златоград“ е разположена в поземлен имот с идентификатор 31111.31.552, съгласно Кадастрална карта и кадастрални регистри на област Смолян, община Златоград, гр. Златоград. Подстанцията се експлоатира от ЕСО ЕАД, управления „Мрежови експлоатационен район Пловдив“ (УМЕР Пловдив), отдел Смолян. Достъпът до подстанцията се осъществява по асфалтов път, част от общинската пътна мрежа на града. Не съществуват ограничения за придвижване на стандартна механизация. Географските координати на п/ст „Златоград“ са: 41°23'18" N и 25°05'11"Е. Предмет на настоящата поръчка е изпълнение на строително-монтажни работи (СМР) по командно-технологичните сгради (КАС и ЗРУ 20 kV), както следва: 1.Сграда за ЗРУ Възстановяване на антикорозионната защита на покривното покритие чрез полагане на антикорозионен грунд и крайно покритие на алкидна основа – боя за метал сребърен феролит; Подмяна на вертикалните отводнители от покривното отводняване; Подмяна на металните врати на северната фасада с пожароустойчиви двукрили плътни врати, клас на огнеустойчивост EI 90; Подмяна на металната дограма на сградата за ЗРУ 20 kV с нова дограма от алуминиев профил с прекъснат термомост, в т.ч съпътстващите ремонта довършителни дейности – обръщане на страници, полагане на крайно покритие и други; Полагане на шпакловка в два пласта с лепило за топлоизолация и силикатна мазилка по фасади. Полагане на грунд и полимерна мозаична мазилка по цокъл със средна височина 60cm и по страници на тераси; Възстановяване на компрометираните участъци от вътрешна мазилка/шпакловка на първи и втори етаж. Цялостно грундиране с импрегниращ грунд за уеднаквяване попивната повърхност по стените, боядисване с латекс по стени; Възстановяване на антикорозионната защита на метални парапети и евакуационни стълби. 2. Командно-административна сграда Подмяна на вертикално покривно отводняване; Възстановяване на компрометираните участъци от външна мазилка. Полагане на грунд и фасадна боя (фасаген) по фасади. Полагане на грунд и полимерна мозаична мазилка по цокъл със средна височина 60 cm; Възстановяване на повърхността и бояджийското покритие по декоративни дървени елементи и обшивки по тераси и стрехи. Подмяна на компрометирани дървени елементи по източни тераси; Подмяна на дървена и метална дограма (врати и прозорци) в избени помещения с алуминиева. Подмяна на метална входна врата за сградата. Подмяна на дървена врата в санитарно помещение на втори етаж. Предвиждат се съществуващите вътрешни метални врати между КАС и ЗРУ 20 kV да се демонтират и да се заменят с пожароустойчиви, плътни врати с клас на огнеустойчивост EI 90; Очукване на компрометирана мазилка/шпакловка в помещенията, частично шпакловане на стени и тавани и боядисване с латекс; В командна зала – подмяна на теракота, очукване на компрометирана шпакловка/мазилка, шпакловка по таван, грундиране и боядисване с латекс; Боядисване на стени, парапети и ръкохватки в стълбищна клетка на сутеренен етаж. ​​​​​​​3. Външна ограда на КАС Демонтаж, доставка и монтаж на масивна дървена пешеходна врата; Възстановяване на повърхността и бояджийското покритие по декоративни дървени елементи по ограда от каменна зидария и навес над входна врата. Добитите строителни отпадъци по време на изпълнение на строителните и монтажните дейности се събират разделно, съгласно изискванията на Наредба № 2/23.07.2014 г. за класификацията на строителните отпадъци и се извозват регулярно до регламентирано сметище.

title: Technology Licensing Opportunity: Electrochemical Recycling Technology for Sustainable Recovery of Tellerium and Cadmium from CdTE Photovoltaics
description: Electrochemical Recycling Technology for Sustainable Recovery of Tellurium and Cadmium from CdTe Photovoltaics In-situ oxidant generation reduces chemical use and environmental impact in solar module recycling Technology Summary This technology enables electrochemical extraction and recovery of tellurium (Te) and cadmium (Cd) from end-of-life and manufacturing scrap cadmium telluride (CdTe) photovoltaic cells. Unlike current recycling methods that rely on externally supplied hydrogen peroxide (H?O?) in acid leaching, this process generates oxidants in situ from oxygen or air using electrochemical methods. The approach decreases reliance on bulk chemicals and significantly lowers the carbon footprint of recycling operations, while still producing Te metal and Cd suitable for reuse in photovoltaic manufacturing. Problem Addressed High environmental footprint of current CdTe PV recycling due to reliance on H?O? production and use. Supply chain and logistics burden from transporting and storing bulk chemicals. Growing need for sustainable recycling as CdTe photovoltaics expand in deployment. Solution Electrochemical in-situ generation of oxidants eliminates external H?O? sourcing. Direct recovery of Te metal and Cd for reintegration into module production. Electricity-driven process supports integration with renewable or nuclear power, lowering lifecycle emissions. Key Advantages Reduced environmental impact: Avoids carbon-intensive bulk chemical manufacturing. Lower logistical burden: Minimizes transportation and storage of hazardous oxidants. Clean energy compatible: Process can run on renewable or low-carbon electricity. Next-generation mining model: Enables sustainable materials recovery aligned with circular economy goals. Market Applications CdTe photovoltaic recycling: Direct application to commercial operations, such as First Solar�s module recovery. Sustainable metals recovery: Broader potential for hydrometallurgical extraction of critical elements. Circular economy strategies: Supports renewable energy companies seeking closed-loop manufacturing.

description: Jyväskylän kaupunki (Tilapalvelu liikelaitos ja kaikki toimialat), Jyväskylän Ammattikorkeakoulu Oy (JAMK), Kiinteistö Oy Tikkakosken Terveysasema, Kiinteistö Oy Jyväskylän Lääkäritalo muodostavat hankintarenkaan ja kilpailuttavat pää- ja arkkitehtisuunnittelun puitejärjestelyn tarjouspyynnön ja sen liitteiden mukaisesti ajalle 2027 ja 2028 sekä optiot vuosille 2029 ja 2030. Tarjouspyynnössä on kaksi osa-aluetta, joista laaditaan omat sopimuksensa. Tarjoaja voi tarjota molempia osa-alueita tai yhtä osa-aluetta. Tarjoaja voi jättää tarjouksen molempiin osa-alueisiin, mutta voi tulla valituksi vain toiseen. Jos tarjoaja tulee valituksi molempiin osa-alueisiin, sillä on oikeus valita, kumpaan osa-alueeseen se osallistuu. Osa-alueet ovat tarkemmin kuvattu tarjouspyynnöllä. Kyseessä on 8 palveluntuottajan puitejärjestely pää- ja arkkitehtisuunnittelusta. Osa-alueeseen 1 valitaan neljä (4) palveluntuottajaa. Osa-alueeseen 2 valitaan neljä (4) palveluntuottajaa. Hankinnan ennakoitu arvo sopimuskaudelle on yhteensä 2 500 0000 euroa. Hankinnan enimmäisarvo sopimuskaudelle on yhteensä 2 700 000 euroa. Enimmäisarvo sisältä varauksen sopimuskauden aikana ennakolta vaikeasti arvioitaviin hankintatarpeisiin, joiden laajuutta ei voida hankintaa käynnistettäessä luotettavasti arvioida. Enimmäisarvo ei kuvaa hankintayksikön sitoutumista hankintamäärään, vaan hankinnan suurinta mahdollista arvoa sopimuskaudella. Jos enimmäisarvo on saavutettu ennen määräaikaisen sopimuksen tai mahdollisesti käyttöön otetun optiokauden päättymisaikaa, puitejärjestely päättyy. Toimittajalla ei tällöin ole mitään vaatimuksia Tilaajaa kohtaan. Suunnittelutehtävissä painottuu koulu- ja päiväkotirakennusten pää- ja arkkitehtisuunnittelutehtävät. Hankinnat tehdään puitesopimuksen luvun 4. Puitejärjestely mukaisesti., OSA-ALUE 2: Kunnossapito Kunnossapidon pää- ja arkkitehtisuunnittelun tehtäviin kuuluu enintään 60 000 euron työt, joihin sisältyvät vuosikorjausten ja pienten perusparannusten sekä muiden vastaavien pienten korjausten suunnittelutyöt. title: Finland – Sludge disposal services – Jätevesimädätteen poiskuljettaminen
description: Hankinta koskee jätevesimädätteen poiskuljettamista Metsäsairila Oy:n alueella (Kiertotaloudenkatu 18, 50800 Mikkeli) toimivan yhtiön omistaman biojalostamon varastosäiliöstä. Mädätteen noutoon tarvitaan imuauto, joka päästöluokituksiltaan täyttää Euro VI -kriteerit. Tarjousasiakirjaan on ladattava vapaamuotoinen tiedosto, josta ilmenevät perustiedot palvelun tuottamiseen käytettävästä kalustosta (merkki, vm, euroluokitus, säiliön tilavuus, akselien lkm, päästöt). Mädäte on orgaanista maanparannusainetta, joka täyttää Ruokaviraston sille lannoitekäyttöön asettamat vaatimukset. Mädätettä ei ole separoitu ja sen kuiva-ainepitoisuus on noin 11,5 %. Mädätteen tuotanto on jatkuvaa ja sitä syntyy noin 3 800 - 5 500 tonnia vuodessa. Tuorein, vuoden 2025 lopun näytteistä koostettu tuoteseloste on lisätty tämän tietopyynnön liiteasiakirjaksi. Tuoreempaa tuoteselostetta ei ole, koska reaktori on ollut huoltotoimien vuoksi poissa tuotantokäytöstä kuluneen kesän ajan. Mädätettä syntyy jatkuvasti, joten sen noutokin on jatkuvatoimista. Mädätteen poiskuljetus tapahtuu tilauksesta, josta palvelun tarjoajalla on 1 viikko aikaa noutaa tuote varastosäiliöstä. Varastosäiliö, jonka vetoisuus on noin 750 t mädätettä, ajetaan tyhjäksi yhdellä kertaa tai toimitaan muulla, yhteisesti sovitulla toimintatavalla. Palvelun tuottajan tulee täyttää kaikki tarjouspyyntöön liittyvät ja mädätteen noudosta aiheutuvat kustannukset. Vastuu tuotteesta ja sen hallinta siirtyvät palvelun tuottajalle, kun se on siirretty varastosäiliöstä imuautoon. Palvelu on oltava tarjolla heti sopimuskauden alkaessa.

title: Pelkosenniemen kunnan tilintarkastuspalvelut 2027-2030 + optio 2031-2032
description: Pelkosenniemen kunnan tilintarkastuspalvelut 2027-2030 + optio 2031-2032 Pelkosenniemen kunta pyytää tarjousta kuntalain (410/2015) mukaisista tilintarkastuspalveluista. Pelkosenniemen kunta on runsaan 900 asukkaan kunta Itä-Lapissa. Kunnan tilinpäätöksen toimintakate vuonna 2025 oli 4,4 miljoonaa euroa. Pelkosenniemen kunta on ulkoistanut kirjanpito- ja palkanlaskentapalvelunsa Monetra Oulu Oy:lle. Hankinnan kohteena on kunnan hallinnon ja talouden tarkastus sekä muut lakisääteiset tilintarkastustehtävät, mukaan lukien kunnan tytäryhteisöjen tilintarkastus. Varsinainen sopimuskausi koskee tilikausien 2027-2030 tilintarkastusta. Hankintayksiköllä on oikeus ottaa käyttöön yksi (1) kahden (2) vuoden optiokausi, joka koskee tilikausien 2031-2032 tilintarkastusta. Palveluun tulee sisältyä vähintään: - kuntalain mukainen hallinnon ja talouden tarkastus; - tilinpäätöksen tarkastus; - tilintarkastuskertomuksen laatiminen; - tarkastuslautakunnan avustaminen sen tarvitsemassa laajuudessa; - osallistuminen tarvittaessa tarkastuslautakunnan kokouksiin; - tarkastushavaintojen raportointi; - muut lakisääteiset tilintarkastustehtävät. Tarkastuksen arvioitu kokonaislaajuus on noin 8 tarkastuspäivää vuodessa. Hankintayksikön arvio sisältää kunnan sekä sen tytäryhteisöjen tilintarkastuksen. Arvio ei sido hankintayksikköä. Tarjoajan tulee laskea tarjoushinta koko vuoden tarkastuksesta omaan arvioonsa perustuen, sisältäen kunnan ja tytäryhtiöiden tarkastuksen. Tilintarkastuspalvelut tarvittavine kokouksineen on mahdollista suorittaa etäyhteyksin. Tarkastuslautakunta pitää 4–6 kokousta vuodessa. Vastuullinen tilintarkastaja osallistuu asiantuntijana tarkastuslautakunnan kokouksiin tarvittaessa, erikseen pyydettäessä. Kokonaishintaan ei tule sisällyttää lautakunnan kokouksiin osallistumista, vaan osallistuminen laskutetaan erikseen ilmoitettavana tuntihintana. description: Vartiointi- ja hälytyskeskuspalvelut Hankinnan kohteena on vartiointi- ja hälytyskeskuspalvelut Kainuun hyvinvointialueella. title: Ortopedian erikoislääkäripalvelut
description: Ortopedian erikoislääkäripalvelut Kainuun hyvinvointialue pyytää tarjouksia ortopedian erikoislääkäripalveluista Kainuun hyvinvointialueelle. Palvelua hankitaan vastaanottopalveluna kirurgian poliklinikalle, päivystyspalveluna vapaamuotoisena päivystyksenä viikonloppu- ja arkiviikkopäivystyksenä sekä leikkaussalipalveluna ja tarvittaessa osastotyöskentelynä kirurgisella osastolla. Vastaanottopalvelu käsittää poliklinikkapäiviä (noin 15 potilasta/päivä). Päivystyspalvelun vapaamuotoinen päivystys viikonloppupäivystyksenä, jolloin työ alkaa perjantaina klo 15.00 ja päättyy maanantaina klo 8.00 (aktiivityön määrä noin 30 - 50 %). Leikkaussalipalvelussa ortopediset toimenpiteet yhdessä leikkaussalissa klo 7.30 - 16.00. Sopimuskausi alkaa 1.1.2027 ja kestää 31.12.2028 saakka. Lisäksi tilaaja varaa option yhdelle (1) vuodelle.,

(i) The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC), National Center for Emerging and Zoonotic Infectious Diseases (NCEZID), Division of Healthcare Quality Promotion (DHQP), announces its intent to compete a new Indefinite-Delivery/Indefinite-Quantity (IDIQ) contract vehicle titled �Safety, Prevention, Epidemiology, and Education Development for Health Care and Antimicrobial Resistance (SPEED).� SPEED will provide CDC with an "as needed" mechanism to obtain healthcare epidemiology, health behavior, and healthcare-associated infection research support across five functional domains: (1) Domestic Antimicrobial Resistance, Infection Prevention and Control, and Adverse Events Services; (2) Healthcare Information Technology and Data Solutions Services; (3) Global Antimicrobial Resistance and Infection Prevention and Control Services; (4) Emergency Preparedness, Response Services, and Healthcare System Resilience Services; and (5) Workforce Training, Message Development, Dissemination, and Testing Services. The anticipated ordering period (period of performance) for the SPEED IDIQ is a 60-month period beginning on March 30, 2027 and ending March 29, 2032. Offerors may submit proposals to one or more domains and will be evaluated on technical approach including existing infrastructure and capacity, staffing approach, management approach, similar experience, price, and past performance. To ensure continuity of critical healthcare epidemiology and infection prevention research support with no lapse in service, DHQP extended the current Safe Healthcare, Epidemiology, Prevention Research Development (SHEPheRD) Program contracts through March 29, 2027, the day immediately preceding the SPEED anticipated effective start date. This extension allows CDC to maintain uninterrupted access to essential scientific, technical, and programmatic support while the SPEED solicitation, evaluation, and award process is completed. DHQP intends for SPEED to fully replace SHEPheRD upon award. CDC will provide further information regarding the solicitation timeline, evaluation criteria, and instructions for interested offerors in forthcoming notices. Interested parties are encouraged to monitor SAM.gov for the official solicitation and any applicable updates. SPEED shall consist of 5 Domains briefly described as follows: Domain 1: Domestic Antimicrobial Resistance, Infection Prevention and Control, and Adverse Events Services. The purpose of this domain is to obtain services that support the design, execution, and assessment of healthcare and community epidemiology research initiatives addressing antimicrobial resistance (AR), infection prevention and control (IPC), and adverse events domestically within U.S. healthcare settings and communities. These implementation services include developing and implementing study protocols, conducting clinical and epidemiologic investigations, evaluating outcomes, and translating research findings into scalable, evidence-based public health interventions. Domain 2: Healthcare Information Technology and Data Solutions Services The purpose of this domain is to obtain services for the development and deployment of digital health systems, advanced analytics, Artificial Intelligence (AI) and machine learning-driven tools, and mathematical modeling to strengthen surveillance, automate data processing, improve data quality, and enhance decision-making across health programs. This includes the ability of Offerors to develop, implement, or maintain healthcare or ancillary medical (e.g., laboratory, pharmacy, etc.) surveillance systems, deploy natural language processing applications and other artificial intelligence tools, conduct human factors engineering, and apply mathematical modeling to optimize system usability, workflow efficiency, and data interpretation Domain 3: Global Antimicrobial Resistance and Infection Prevention and Control Services The purpose of this domain is to obtain services for development and implementation of research projects and protocols focused on antimicrobial stewardship, antimicrobial resistance detection and control, global health coordination, surveillance, and prevention of healthcare-associated infections in global healthcare settings. These tasks include, but are not limited to, conducting program evaluations, clinical investigations, cost effectiveness and disease modeling analyses, and translating findings into scalable and sustainable public health interventions with a particular focus on low- and middle-income countries. Domain 4: Emergency Preparedness, Response Services, and Healthcare System Resilience Services The purpose of this domain is to obtain services to rapidly respond to healthcare quality and safety threats. Services that may be conducted under this domain include supporting CDC's ability to respond effectively and rapidly to outbreaks, emergencies, and public health threats during times of healthcare facility or health system stress or strain. Domain 5: Workforce Training, Message Development, Dissemination and Testing Services The purpose of this domain is to obtain services that strengthen the capacity, knowledge, and preparedness of healthcare workers, public health personnel (including CDC staff), and the general public to prevent infections and reduce the spread of antimicrobial resistance and other infectious disease threats. title: OSTWIND Market Development 2027–2029
description:
Current Situation

OSTWIND and the participating cantons aim to shift commuter traffic toward public transportation and other sustainable modes of transportation. During the current contract period, data-driven potential analyses, business development activities, corporate mobility concepts, licensing agreements, and operational processes were established. Ongoing corporate projects will continue beyond the end of the current contract.


The contractor must therefore fulfill two tasks simultaneously: attract new companies or clusters of companies with high potential for shifting to public transit, and ensure the continuity of existing projects. The contract is structured as a comprehensive service, ranging from market prioritization and negotiations to stable implementation, ongoing support and further development, as well as an orderly handover.


Crucial is the contractor’s ability to design effective processes, coordinate them with OSTWIND and the contracting cantons, put them into operation, monitor them, and further develop them. Proprietary solutions that serve to fulfill the objectives of this contract may be offered separately to corporate clients, provided that the client’s own or other suitable implementation methods are supported to an equivalent degree and that economic interests and dependencies are disclosed transparently.


Project Objectives

The project aims to use data to identify suitable companies and locations with significant relocation potential, approach them, and persuade them to adopt corporate mobility concepts. In collaboration with the companies (clients), OSTWIND, the contracting cantons, and other partners, economically and operationally viable solutions are to be developed and brought to the decision-making stage.


The agreed-upon mobility concepts are to be translated into functional and manageable operational processes, supported throughout the contract period, and further developed based on usage and impact. At the same time, existing company projects must continue without interruption, and the necessary conditions for a future handover and sustainable continued operation must be established. Annual targets (e.g., acquisition of [number] companies with [number] employees, etc.) will be agreed upon with the contractor.


General Terms and Conditions

OSTWIND is awarding a contract for the term from January 1, 2027, to December 31, 2029. There are two options to extend the contract by one year each (maximum contract term: 5 years). OSTWIND has sole discretion to decide whether to exercise the extension options. The decision to extend the mandate is made separately for each option year. Exercising the first extension option does not confer any entitlement to a further one-year extension.


The contractor bears overall responsibility for the methodological, organizational, and procedural integration of the defined work packages. The scope covers the OSTWIND fare network area and the cantons participating in the program: AI, AR, GL, SG, SH, TG, SZ (March only). The focus is on employers, business locations, and clusters with significant potential for sustainable workplace mobility and a substantial connection to public transportation. Municipalities, cantons, transportation companies, and complementary mobility providers will be involved as needed.


The targeted performance objectives are set forth in the tender documents and the associated appendices. The quantities specified serve as planning guidelines and do not constitute a purchase guarantee, unless expressly stated otherwise.


Components of the Request for Proposals

Appendix 1: Requirements Catalog

Appendix 2: Case Study

Appendix 3: References and Key Personnel

Appendix 4: Price Sheet

description: Die Stadt Nordhausen baut die Wallrothstraße grundhaft aus. Die Maßnahme wird in mehreren Bauabschnitten durchgeführt. Im 1. Bauabschnitt (Station 0-085 bis 0+340) ist der Ausbau einschließlich eines neuen Regenwasserkanals bereits erfolgt. Mit diesem Verfahren werden die Bauleistungen für den 2. Bauabschnitt von Bau-km 0+340 bis Bau-km 0+508 ausgeschrieben (in dieser Bekanntgabe unter Punkt 5 als LOT-0001 geführt). Die Straße verläuft in diesem Abschnitt in ausgeprägter Hanglage. Die talseitige Böschung ist nicht standsicher; die Standsicherheit wird über drei Ingenieurbauwerke hergestellt, die den Schwerpunkt der Maßnahme bilden: - eine überschnittene Bohrpfahlwand von Station 0+400 bis 0+508, Länge rd. 108 m, abgewickelte Wandfläche rd. 1.350 m², Großbohrpfähle nach DIN EN 1536 mit D = 88 cm, rückverankert mit 29 Mikropfählen nach DIN EN 14199; darauf Kopfbalken und Kappe aus Stahlbeton, - eine Winkelstützwand aus Stahlbetonfertigteilen von Station 0+420 bis 0+508, Länge rd. 90 m, - eine Böschungsstabilisierung in bewehrter Erde mit Geogittern von Station 0+340 bis 0+400. Hinzu kommen der grundhafte Straßenausbau einschließlich Oberflächenentwässerung, ein gemeinsamer Geh- und Radweg, der abschnittsweise über die Kappe der Bohrpfahlwand geführt wird, eine Querungshilfe mit Bodenindikatoren, die Straßenbeleuchtung sowie die Anpassung des bergseitigen Waldweges. Besondere Randbedingungen der Ausführung: - Der Baubereich steht unter Kampfmittelverdacht; vor den Erd- und Bohrarbeiten ist eine Sondierung erforderlich. - Unter der Bestandsfahrbahn befindet sich eine mit polyzyklischen aromatischen Kohlenwasserstoffen belastete Packlage. Für deren Ausbau gelten der Leitfaden C 316 und die TRGS 551. - Im Baufeld verläuft eine in Betrieb befindliche Mittelspannungstrasse des örtlichen Netzbetreibers, die während der Bauzeit zu sichern ist. - Die Baumfäll- und Rodungsarbeiten unterliegen der Bindung nach § 39 Abs. 5 BNatSchG und sind nur außerhalb der Zeit vom 1. März bis 30. September zulässig. - Die Arbeitsebene für die Bohrpfahlarbeiten ist die vorhandene Fahrbahn mit einer befestigten Breite von rd. 5,65 m. Die Baumaßnahme wird in drei zeitlich getrennten Ausführungsabschnitten ausgeführt: - Abschnitt 1: Baumfäll- und Gehölzarbeiten, 18.01.2027 bis 28.02.2027. - Abschnitt 2.1: Hauptbaumaßnahme, 03/2027 bis 12/2027. - Abschnitt 2.2: Fertigstellung der Hauptbaumaßnahme, 04/2028 bis 06/2028. Zwischen Abschnitt 1 und Abschnitt 2.1 ruhen die Arbeiten. Zwischen Abschnitt 2.1 und Abschnitt 2.2 liegt die Winterunterbrechung ab dem 18.12.2027. Eine Unterteilung der hier ausgeschriebenen Leistung in weitere Lose ist nicht vorgesehen.
